key_insight: MAPS uses a centralized master agent to emit a compact continuous proto-plan that guides decentralized vehicle controllers, separating global coordination from local driving decisions.
engineering_relevance: This hierarchy reduces MARL complexity at unsignalized intersections and supports scalable, transferable coordination across different vehicle counts and intersection layouts.
method: Master agent generates a latent proto-plan encoding the coordination strategy
Worker agents combine proto-plan with local observations for vehicle-specific control
Independent optimization of strategy and execution modules enables scalable training and deployment
evidence_signal: Evaluated in HighwayEnv across 72 intersection configurations, MAPS achieved collision-free navigation with lower travel time and reached 94% zero-shot success when trained on three agents and deployed to five-agent scenarios.
watch_item: Results are from a simulation-based proof of concept, so real-world robustness, sensing noise, and safety validation remain open concerns.
paper_title: Compact Latent Coordination for Autonomous Vehicles at Unsignalized Intersections
